title: Technical Report on Text Dataset Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias inheritance in distilled datasets using occupation classification tasks (e.g., Bias in Bios) and mitigating it through dataset balancing and adversarial training to make representations uninformative to specific target labels.

Evaluating fairness in binary sentiment analysis tasks on datasets featuring demographic dialectal variation (African-American English), utilizing pre-processing for class balance and adversarial training components.
